name: Manim Animation Studio
author: AI Plate & Manim Community
description: Programmatic mathematical and scientific animation studio powered by Manim Community Edition. Render geometric transformations, calculus proofs, dynamic charts, and scientific motion graphics.

tools.name: manim_render
tools.description: Render a mathematical or technical animation using Manim Community Edition. Automatically compiles Python Scene code into high-fidelity MP4 or GIF videos, delivers deliverables to the artifacts folder, and provides rich interactive visual cards.

scene_code.description: Complete Python script defining one or more Manim Scene classes (e.g. `from manim import *; class MyScene(Scene): ...`)

scene_name.description: Specific Scene class name to render (leave blank to auto-detect the first Scene class in the code)

output_filename.description: Optional custom filename for the output video (e.g. 'pythagorean_proof.mp4')

tools.name: manim_check_env
tools.description: Inspect the Python runtime for Manim Community Edition and FFmpeg, or provision an isolated virtual environment.

tools.name: manim_sample_templates
tools.description: Retrieve ready-to-render Manim Community template scenes (shapes morphing, coordinate calculus parabola, or animated bar chart).

handler.code:
const tmpl = String(params.template || 'shapes_morph').trim();

const templates = {
  shapes_morph: `from manim import *

class ShapesMorph(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("AI Plate × Manim", font_size=40, color=BLUE)
        self.play(Write(title))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(FadeOut(title))

        square = Square(side_length=2.5, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.6)
        circle = Circle(radius=1.5, color=RED, fill_opacity=0.7)
        triangle = Triangle(color=YELLOW, fill_opacity=0.8).scale(1.8)

        self.play(Create(square))
        self.play(square.animate.rotate(PI / 4))
        self.play(Transform(square, circle))
        self.play(Transform(square, triangle))
        self.play(FadeOut(square, scale=0.5))
`,
  math_parabola_axes: `from manim import *

class ParabolaMinima(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-3, 3, 1], y_range=[-1, 5, 1], x_length=7, y_length=5, axis_config={"color": BLUE_C})
        labels = axes.get_axis_labels(x_label="x", y_label="f(x)")
        title = Text("f(x) = x² - 2x + 1", font_size=32, color=YELLOW).to_edge(UP)

        self.play(Create(axes), Write(labels), Write(title))
        parabola = axes.plot(lambda x: x**2 - 2*x + 1, x_range=[-1.5, 3], color=GREEN)
        self.play(Create(parabola))

        dot = Dot(color=RED).move_to(axes.c2p(1, 0))
        min_lbl = Text("Min (1,0)", font_size=18, color=RED).next_to(dot, DOWN)
        self.play(FadeIn(dot, scale=2), Write(min_lbl))
        self.wait(1)
`,
  bar_chart_metrics: `from manim import *

class BarChartMetrics(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Inference Latency (ms)", font_size=30, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.play(Write(title))

        models = ["Baseline", "Optimized", "AI Plate"]
        vals = [180, 110, 42]
        cols = [RED, ORANGE, GREEN]

        bars = VGroup()
        for i, (m, v, c) in enumerate(zip(models, vals, cols)):
            bar = Rectangle(width=1.6, height=(v/200)*4, color=c, fill_color=c, fill_opacity=0.8)
            bar.move_to([-3.0 + i*3.0, -2.5 + (v/200)*2, 0])
            lbl = Text(m, font_size=18, color=WHITE).next_to(bar, DOWN)
            v_lbl = Text(f"{v}ms", font_size=20, color=YELLOW).next_to(bar, UP)
            bars.add(VGroup(bar, lbl, v_lbl))

        baseline = Line([-4.5, -2.5, 0], [4.5, -2.5, 0], color=GRAY)
        self.play(Create(baseline), *[FadeIn(b, shift=UP) for b in bars])
        self.wait(1.5)
`
};

const code = templates[tmpl] || templates.shapes_morph;
return {
  template: tmpl,
  scene_code: code,
  instructions: 'Pass this scene_code directly into manim_render to compile this animation.'
};
